text: Computer vision is a field of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand images and videos. One important task is image recognition, which allows a computer to identify what is in a picture, such as a person, an animal, or an object. Another key task is object detection, which means finding and locating several objects in the same image. These technologies have many useful applications in everyday life. For example, self-driving cars use computer vision to see the road, recognise traffic signs, and detect other vehicles and people. Computer vision is also used in security cameras and medical imaging, making our lives safer and easier.
